2. **Right to Buy reform** — protecting new council homes from being sold, to incentivize building

The core substance is government policy on social housing supply: protecting council-built homes from Right to Buy so councils will build more. This is about housing supply and government policy affecting it.

Checking the codes:
- R31 — Housing Supply and Markets: fits the building/supply dimension
- R38 — Government Policy (under Real Estate Markets): fits the policy instrument (Right to Buy reform, rent convergence)
- R28 — Government Policy (under Household Analysis): less precise
- R52 — Land Use and Other Regulations: not quite

The most precise match is **R38** — Government Policy within Real Estate Markets, as the quotation is specifically about government policy instruments (Right to Buy reform, rent convergence) affecting housing supply. R31 is the substantive area (housing supply), and R38 is the government policy code within that same major subcategory.

Since R38 is the government policy code under R3 (Real Estate Markets), and the mechanism is specifically about housing supply policy, R38 fits well as the detailed code.
